# Content and Authoring Requirements Quality Checklist: The portfolio

**Purpose**: Validate the one-file-plus-images authoring, build error and draft requirements are complete, clear and testable.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## One-file Authoring

- [ ] CHK001 Is "one text file plus its images, with no other change" bounded, including where images live and how they are referenced? [Clarity, Spec §FR-070]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the slug rules defined (derived from the file name, allowed characters, case, length, reserved words)? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the order setting's behaviour defined for ties, gaps, negative values and a missing order? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the theme and status vocabularies defined as closed lists, and who adds a new one? [Completeness, Spec §FR-071]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the seven-chapter contract stated once with the chapter names and markers Don must write, and is the last chapter's invitation authored or generated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the required versus optional settings listed without contradiction between Key Entities and FR-071? [Consistency, Spec §FR-071]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the date setting's format and its role in ordering or display specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-071]
- [ ] CHK008 Is sharing image fallback behaviour defined when no sharing image is set? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-080]
- [ ] CHK009 Can the success criterion "exactly one text file plus its images" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the building blocks' inputs and allowed nesting (existing page sections inside chapters) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-072]

## Build Errors

- [ ] CHK011 Is "plain-language message naming the file and the problem" defined with required message parts (file, field, expected, found)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-073]
- [ ] CHK012 Is each error class in FR-073 mapped to a distinct, testable condition, including "wrong kind" and "clashing slug"? [Measurability, Spec §FR-073, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for several errors at once (all reported versus first only) and across several files? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the "at least" in FR-073 bounded so additional error classes are not left open-ended? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-073]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the 140-character limit's counting rule (characters, whitespace, one sentence) unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-071]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the missing-list rules for favour and against points state that no error occurs, and is a partially filled list handled? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK017 Are error requirements defined for image problems beyond missing (unsupported format, oversize, unreadable)? [Gap, Spec §FR-073]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the requirement that errors surface identically in local development, preview and CI builds stated? [Coverage, Gap]

## Drafts: Preview versus Production

- [ ] CHK019 Is "preview deployment" distinguished from production in a way the build can decide objectively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-074]
- [ ] CHK020 Are draft exclusions enumerated across index, story page, sitemap, sharing metadata, search and link checks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-074, Spec §FR-081]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the visible "Draft" marker specified for both the index row and the story page? [Consistency, Spec §FR-074]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the rules for a draft project's contact link and order slot defined, and does a draft-only portfolio yield a valid empty index? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the marking for Don-review placeholder text and media distinguished from the draft flag? [Clarity, Spec §FR-082]
- [ ] CHK024 Is it specified that a draft still fails the build on invalid content? [Gap, Spec §FR-073]

## Guide and Integration

- [ ] CHK025 Does the authoring guide requirement cover every setting, block and error message, with a way to keep them in sync? [Measurability, Spec §FR-075]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the change to the reserved-address list and link-check expectations specified for both the index and each story? [Completeness, Spec §FR-081]
- [ ] CHK027 Is Focus Pocus's placeholder content boundary defined so the "built only from a project file" claim is checkable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-082]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the constitution's plain-language writing rule reflected in requirements for placeholder copy and labels? [Traceability, Gap]
